title: core.command.v1 BalanceInquiry payload
description: Balance inquiry (ADR D26): the core answers the wallet's available balance with BalanceReported, or BalanceInquiryRejected (reasonCode WALLET_NOT_FOUND, WALLET_NOT_ACTIVE, MW-AUTH-046). Sent by mw-orchestrator on core.wallet.command.v1 for txnType BALANCE. Moves no money. Shaped like a transfer so the core checks mw-auth's assertion the same way: txnType BALANCE, amount 0, creditParty = debitParty (the customer's own wallet), with the request's idempotencyKey for the txnHash. The middleware never stores the answer (spec 3, rule 1).

debitParty.description: The wallet whose balance is asked for.

amount.description: Always 0 for BALANCE (checked by mw-orchestrator, mw-auth and the core).

idempotencyKey.description: The mw.txn.request.v1 idempotencyKey; part of the assertion's txnHash.
